styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm minimal fashion ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream paper background #FAF6E8, warm khaki-sage panel #B5AF9C, deep charcoal text #2D2C28, and one madder-red accent #BF4432; warm soft diffused lighting with gentle shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with wide letter-spaced uppercase English headers and short Chinese subtitles in 「」; alternating cream and khaki flat panels with thin-bordered image cards; consistent thin-line garment icons; cozy knitwear photography with true fabric texture and soft contact shadows; stable product scale and calm open composition; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 14 张 800×1200 切片（相邻重叠 60px）按序拼合自一条详情页长图后逐片分析。源文案三种互相矛盾（女款羊羔绒外套/男款摇粒绒夹克/男款棉衣），且部分切片缺失产品影像，全部可见服装实物均为奶油白麻花圆领针织毛衣，按本夹先例『文案与实物矛盾以图为准』判定主产品并归入女装/上衣。已剥离：领标品牌字、会员二维码贴片、新疆棉产地统计类文案、逐字服务条款、填充式卖点长句；源『男士尺寸表』数字不适用于本品类，仅保留通用尺码表结构，尺码数值在生成时填入。保留为视觉语法：奶油纸底+卡其灰绿版式、属性标尺信息图、衣架陈列、折叠多色陈列、服务须知卡片。不确定点：规格页所列四色属于矛盾文案，VARIANT 配色留待生成时 hex 指定；部分切片图块缺失产品影像，仅能提取版式结构。
